title: Game registry entry
description: One game on games.markusmayer.dev. Editorial fields are written by hand; `release` and `web.sha256` are rewritten by scripts/sync-game.ts when the game's repository announces a release.

slug.description: URL segment and build folder. Must equal the file name without .json.

repo.description: GitHub owner/name. Only releases from this repository are accepted for this entry.

order.description: Sort key on the index page; lower first. Ties sort by release date, newest first.

frame.description: The machine it stands in: a beige VGA monitor or an arcade cabinet.

platform.description: The era it is styled on, e.g. "DOS PC, VGA 320×200".

accent.description: The colour its screen throws into the room.

web.description: Present for games that run in the browser. The release asset is a zip with an index.html using relative paths; it is self-hosted under /builds/<slug>/<version>/ and framed by /<slug>/.

asset.description: Release asset name; {version} is replaced by the tag.

aspect.description: CSS aspect-ratio of the play frame, e.g. "16 / 10".

native.description: The game's own screen in pixels. Games that scale by whole numbers get their frame at the next whole multiple of this, scaled down to fit.

module.description: Embed the game in the page: its wasm-bindgen module in the build folder, e.g. "cheese.js". Needs `canvas`. The Play click then counts for the game, so its sound may start at once.

canvas.description: The id of the canvas the game binds to, e.g. "cheese".

restart.description: The event the embedded game restarts on, dispatched on its canvas with the options as detail.

options.description: Launch options for the default start: data attributes on an embedded game's canvas, a query string for a framed one.

variants.description: Named ways to launch the same build, shown as buttons; the first is what Play starts.

attest.description: Require a GitHub build-provenance attestation for the zip.

cover.description: Title art from the game's repository at the release tag. scripts/sync-game.ts re-pins sha256 on every release; the build serves it from /covers/<slug>-<hash>.<ext>.

path.description: Path in the game repository to a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or AVIF.

links.description: Extra links: downloads, store pages, source. A game without `web` is played through these.

url.description: {version} is replaced by the current release tag.
